About

Tournament of Brilliance II is a two-day Free-for-All (FFA) tournament organised by the Cynosure clan.

As the second edition of the Tournament of Brilliance series, the event features up to 100 players competing individually across a rotation of maps. Players accumulate points based on their match placements and in-game performance over the course of two days to determine the final standings.

Format

General

  • Game Mode: Free-for-All (FFA)
  • Players: 100
  • Dates: November 1st and 2nd

Map Rotation

The following 5 maps were played in this exact rotation on each matchday:

  • Pluto
  • Africa
  • Gateway
  • Asia
  • Europe

Scoring System

Players earn points based on their placement in each match:

  • 1st place: 10 points
  • 2nd place: 7 points
  • 3rd place: 5 points
  • 4th place: 3 points
  • 5th place: 1 point


In addition:

  • Each kill: 1 point
  • Final placement is determined by the largest territory size each player reached at any moment during a match, not by the end screen ranking.
  • Final rank ties are split according to average position.

Rules

  • No teaming
  • No ruination
  • No toxicity
  • No spawn killing
  • No MIRVs
